title: Write 5 · 点 过 大 从 下 中 真 年 家 怎 听 先 国 学 校
focus: 点 过 大 从 下 中 真 年 家 怎 听 先 国 学 校
body:
Repeating parts: 口 (听, 点's 占, 国), 日-shapes (真, 早-like), 人 (从, 大), 宀 roof (家), ⺍ (学), 木 (校), 乍 (怎).

## Rules that matter here
- **Centre stroke last when it pierces**: 中, 年 (the long vertical ends the character).
- **Outside, inside, close**: 国.
- 辶 last again in 过.

cards.Notes: 占 (5: 卜 + 口, phonetic zhàn) + 灬 fire dots (4) = 9 strokes. Top before bottom; four dots left to right.
寸 (3) + 辶 walk (3) = 6 strokes. Write 寸 first, 辶 LAST. Also neutral guo after verbs (去过).
3 strokes: 一, ノ, ㇏. Horizontal first, left-falling before right-falling. A person with arms spread. Lookalikes: 太, 犬, 天.
Two 人 people (2 + 2) = 4 strokes. Left 人 first; its ㇏ shrinks to a dot. One person following another.
3 strokes: 一 first, then 丨, then the dot. Mirror of 上 (where the vertical comes first).
口 (3) + one long vertical = 4 strokes. Box first, then the central vertical through it LAST.
十 (2) + 目-like (5) + long 一 + 八-like two dots (2) = 10 strokes. Top to bottom. Lookalike: 直 (8).
6 strokes: ノ, 一, 一, short left 丨, long 一, then the long vertical LAST. Lookalike: 午 (4).
宀 roof (3) + 豕 pig (7) = 10 strokes. Roof first. A pig under a roof = household. Lookalike: 象.
乍 (5, phonetic zhà) + 心 heart (4) = 9 strokes. Top before bottom. Lookalike: 作 (亻 + 乍), 昨 (日 + 乍).
口 mouth (3) + 斤 (4, phonetic-ish jīn) = 7 strokes. Left small 口 first. Lookalike: 所, 近 (also 斤).
⺧ (4: ノ, 一, 丨, 一) + 儿 legs (2) = 6 strokes. Top before bottom; 儿 ends with 竖弯钩.
囗 enclosure + 玉 jade (5) = 8 strokes. Outside before inside, close last: 丨, 横折, then 玉 (dot last), bottom 一.
⺍ (3) + 冖 cover (2) + 子 child (3) = 8 strokes. Top to bottom. Lookalike: 觉 (见 at bottom).
木 tree (4) + 交 (6, phonetic jiāo) = 10 strokes. 交 = 亠 + 父. Left before right.
